sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: We are launching Qwen-Image-3.0, the third-generation foundational image generation model in the Qwen-Image series. If the keyword for Qwen-Image-1. was "Precision", and the keywords for Qwen-Image-2. were "Precision, Variety, Completeness, Beauty, and Authenticity", then the core of Qwen-Image-3. comes down to a single word — "Real" (实).

sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B Medical LoRA Fine-Tuning Tutorial - GitHub
sources.snippet: What This Project Does Fine-tunes Qwen2.5-.5B-Instruct (498M parameters) with LoRA SFT on 640 Chinese medical Q&A samples, then compares base vs. fine-tuned model outputs.

sources.title: Q-LoRA Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Q-LoRA fine-tuning provides an efficient way to adapt Qwen models to specific tasks with limited computational resources. By using quantized models and low-rank adaptation, it enables fine-tuning of large language models on consumer hardware while maintaining good performance.

sources.title: Qwen Image Models Training - 0 to Hero Level Tutorial - LoRA ... - Medium
sources.snippet: This tutorial covers how to do LoRA training and full Fine-Tuning / DreamBooth training on Qwen Image models. It covers both the Qwen Image base model and the Qwen Image Edit Plus 2509 model.
